Company Description
PipeFX builds the systems behind creative and media production at scale — the pipelines, services and tooling that turn a good idea into something that runs reliably, every time.
We're a small, senior team, and we work the way we think software is going in 2026: heavy use of AI and agentic tooling, short paths from idea to production, and very little process for its own sake. Clean architecture and maintainable code matter here — not as slogans, but because we ship fast and have to live with what we built.
If you join us, you'll be in production code early. You'll have senior engineers to learn from, and you'll be expected to have opinions. We hire on what people can build, and we make room for people to grow into more than they were hired for.
PipeFX is committed to inclusive hiring and to building a team where everyone has a real shot at doing their best work.
Role Description

- Turning loosely defined requirements into working technical solutions, alongside senior engineers
- Writing clean, efficient code and taking code review seriously — both directions
- Debugging, refactoring, and writing unit and integration tests
- Deploying updates, watching how they behave in production, and responding when something breaks
- Documenting what you built so the next person doesn't have to reverse-engineer it
What we care about most: that you can take a vague problem, break it down, and drive it to a result without needing someone to hand you the next step.
hybrid, on-site in Ramat Gan.
